Local customer status is judged per obligor from a fixed seed as of the reference date, not per exposure; if one obligor's loans were split between local and Korean-affiliated, an obligor-based ratio would not hold. Loan amounts are all observed.
해외 직원수 ÷ 총 직원수 — 인사 원장이 없어 해외점포 원장 부재 —: Overseas headcount / total headcount; no HR ledger, no overseas office ledger; fixed-seed derived value as of the reference date

수익자 구분 원장이 없다. 기관투자자 몫만 파생으로 떼어내고 나머지 개인: There is no beneficiary type ledger. Only the institutional investor portion is split off as derived; the remaining retail/corporate split uses **the observed retail and corporate deposit shares** as is, because drawing a new beneficiary mix would make the same bank's customer mix differ between the deposit forms and the fund forms.
계좌 원장이 없다. 계좌수를 따로 뽑지 않고 잔액 ÷ 계좌당 평잔으로 만: There is no account ledger. Account counts are not drawn separately but built as balance / average balance per account so that the three reconcile within the form. Accounts by type and accounts by beneficiary split the same total account count along different axes.
서민의 금융생활 지원에 관한 법률 — 휴면예금 출연: Act on Support for Financial Life of the Underprivileged: dormant deposit contributions
휴면예금 롤포워드 원장이 없다. **기말잔액을 앵커로 두고 기초잔액을 역: There is no dormant deposit roll-forward ledger. **The closing balance is the anchor and the opening balance is back-solved**, so the identity opening + new minus refunds minus contributions = closing always holds. Drawing the four separately would have left a residual.
개인 예수금(실측) × 파생 미거래율 · 합계는 재무상태표 예수금(실측): Retail deposits (observed) x derived no-transaction rate; the total is anchored to balance sheet deposits (observed); only the split is derived
미거래 예금은 휴면 도래 전 단계이며 원장이 없다. 총계는 휴면예금과 같: No-transaction deposits are the stage before dormancy and have no ledger. The total is anchored to the same retail deposits (observed) as dormant deposits, and only the elapsed-period and amount-band splits are derived. The two axes split the same total differently, so each is reconciled to the total.
서민의 금융생활 지원에 관한 법률 — 휴면성 신탁금·수표 출연: Act on Support for Financial Life of the Underprivileged: dormant trust money and cheque contributions
자기앞수표 발행대금 × 파생 휴면율 · 합계는 재무상태표 예수금(실측): Cashier's cheque issuance proceeds x derived dormancy rate; the total is anchored to balance sheet deposits (observed); only the split is derived
법인 결제성 예수금(실측) × 파생 발행비율 · 합계는 재무상태표 예수금: Corporate transactional deposits (observed) x derived issuance ratio; the total is anchored to balance sheet deposits (observed); only the split is derived

Assignment is per exposure, so eligible >= applied >= accepted holds automatically within the form. To capture that obligors whose credit improved apply and are accepted, probability rises as PD falls. Sovereign and bank exposures are not eligible for rate reduction requests and were removed from the population.
